feeds.title: Gastronomic Salt Lake City
feeds.description: All the latest Utah food and drink news. Gastronomic Salt Lake City is Utah's longest running online magazine covering the food and beverage scene. Bringing reviews, news, info and giveaways since 2009, if its worth eating, drinking or knowing about we'll let you know.

feeds.title: Two Peas & Their Pod
feeds.description: Maria Lichty shares recipes that are simple, fresh, and family friendly.She is a food blogger, recipe developer, and writer.

feeds.title: Pretty Providence
feeds.description: Learn to celebrate and LIVE YOUR BEST LIFE with incredibly fun and easy recipes, DIY tutorials, crafts, tips and more to share with friends and family.

feeds.title: Completely Delicious
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Annalise and I love to bake! Here you'll find recipes, baking tips, and more.

feeds.title: Foodie Crush
feeds.description: The food blog with mostly healthy recipes made with real, whole foods inspiring more people to get into the kitchen and cook something good.

feeds.title: Barbara Bakes
feeds.description: All of Barbara's wonderful recipes will remain on the site and Melissa will be adding new cookie, cake, pie, muffin, and other baking recipes to the site every week. The quality and tradition of Barbara's recipes will continue with fun new additions that Melissa is sure you'll love too.

feeds.title: Oh Sweet Basil
feeds.description: A food blog with a family-first focus offering simple easy-to-prepare recipes perfect for the traditional family dinner. Sweet Basil is all about reinventing family dinner. We're sharing everything from how to make the perfect rolls to cookie dough pie and healthy foods for balance in between.

feeds.title: Oh My Tech!
feeds.description: From parents who are just starting out to those with kids who are grown and flown, this is the technology podcast that focuses on using the technology in your life to make it better!Oh My Tech will bring you how to's, help you discover scams, give you the latest news or trending topics, and even help you find something to watch. Join Sarah Kimmel as she breaks down tech in ways that anyone can understand! Learn more at https://familytech.biz

feeds.title: Six Sisters' Stuff
feeds.description: We share easy recipes, simple cookbooks, and picky-eater approved meal plans to help you bring your family back to the dinner table. We're six biological sisters who love to share our recipes with each other and YOU.

feeds.title: Jamie Cooks It Up
feeds.description: Hi! I am Jamie Eskelson. Jamie Cooks It Up! has been up and running since October of 2009. There are over 1300 family friendly recipes living and breathing on this site. My goal is to share fabulous recipes that are sure to put a smile on your face.

feeds.title: Wanderzest Blog
feeds.description: Explore the world through a variety of recipes, traditional foods to fusion recipes, different food experiences and more on the blog. Wanderzest is a fun and adventurous food and travel blog created to encourage you to explore new foods and cultures.

feeds.title: chew and chat
feeds.description: A Bite of Utah Food News. Valerie Sagers Phillips has covered food news for over 20 years in her popular newspaper column and her blog, ChewandChat. She is also the author of 'Soup's On!' (Covenant, 2012) with 100 fast and fabulous soups, stews and chili recipes.

feeds.title: Foodscaping Utah Blog
feeds.description: News and Events from Foodscaping Utah. It is a volunteer group striving to help people in Northern Utah transform their frontyards into well designed edible landscapes.

feeds.title: Ashlee Marie
feeds.description: Cake decorating tutorials, from scratch recipes, culinary travel and over the top parties. Ashlee is a self-taught baker, chef, cake decorator, and teacher.

feeds.title: Frieda Loves Bread
feeds.description: A blog about cooking, baking, pressure cooking and kitchen tips. Frieda loves to bake bread, learn new tips, and teach. Her mission is to help you create home baked memories for you and your family through step by step photo tutorials!
